items.quote: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.
items.claim: According to the text (Genesis 22:6), Abraham put the wood for the burnt offering on his son Isaac. Abraham carried the fire and a knife himself, and the two walked on together.
items.action: laid the burnt-offering wood upon Isaac and carried the fire and a knife
items.object: wood of the burnt offering; fire; knife
items.mechanism: Abraham divides what is needed for the offering between the two of them: Isaac carries the wood, and Abraham carries the fire and the knife.
